As-of join.description: aj[c;t1;t2]: each row of t1 with the columns of the last row of t2 at or before its time, matched on the other columns of c; t2 sorted by them, ideally `p#sym

As-of join, time of the match.description: aj0[c;t1;t2]: as aj, with the time of the row of t2 it matched in place of t1's

Window join.description: wj[w;c;t;(q;(f;c)..)]: each row of t with the aggregates of the rows of q within its window, those prevailing at its start included

Window join, rows inside the window.description: wj1[w;c;t;(q;(f;c)..)]: as wj, over only the rows of q inside each window

Left join.description: t lj kt: each row of t with the columns of the row of the keyed table kt its key columns match, nulls where none does

Inner join.description: t ij kt: the rows of t whose key columns match a row of the keyed table kt, with that row's columns

Union join.description: t1 uj t2: the rows of both, with the columns of both, nulls where a table lacks one

Bucketed select.description: select ... by n xbar time: one row per group and bucket of n, a bar of the data

Synchronous message handler.description: .z.pg: what a client's synchronous query evaluates to; q's own is value

Asynchronous message handler.description: .z.ps: what runs on a client's asynchronous message; nothing is sent back

Connection opened.description: .z.po: called with the handle of each connection a client opens

Connection closed.description: .z.pc: called with the handle of each connection that closes, after it has

Password check.description: .z.pw: whether user, with this password as a string, may connect; 0b refuses

Timer.description: .z.ts and \t: run every n milliseconds with the time, from now; \t 0 stops it

WebSocket message handler.description: .z.ws: called with each WebSocket message; neg[.z.w] sends back to that client

Exit handler.description: .z.exit: called with the exit code as the process exits
